Canton of Bern · 스위스 (한국어)

Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region (Berner Oberland) — 스위스 여행 가이드: 명소, 교통편 & 지역 맛집

Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau peaks, Lauterbrunnen's 72 waterfalls, Wengen, Mürren and Lake Thun & Brienz.

지역 / 광역시·도Canton of Bern
추천 방문 시기Apr–Jun & Sep–Oct
Stay3–5 days

도시 개요

Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region (Berner Oberland) is one of the essential stops in Switzerland, located in the Canton of Bern region. Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau peaks, Lauterbrunnen's 72 waterfalls, Wengen, Mürren and Lake Thun & Brienz.

With direct connections via SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways, Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region rewards a stay of 3–5 days so you can balance major landmarks with neighborhood cafés, markets, and easy half-day excursions.

가는 법 및 대중교통

Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region is served by SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways and intercity express trains as well as regional airport transfers. Book high-speed legs 2–6 weeks ahead for early-bird fares.

The historic core of Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region is best explored on foot, supplemented by contactless tap-to-pay metro, tram, or bus lines.

추천 숙박 지역

  • Budget: Well-connected hostels and guesthouses within a 10-minute walk of Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region's central station or metro lines.
  • Mid-range: Boutique 3-to-4-star hotels near the historic center and pedestrian promenade.
  • Luxury: Heritage 5-star grand hotels and design properties with concierge access and views.
